release_notes.text: Removed the retired legacy configuration and Daily Brief delivery migration CLI surfaces; installations must already use YAML authoring and current delivery state before upgrading.
Removed active `yield_enhancement` naming and configuration aliases in favor of `combo_yield`, while preserving read-only interpretation of historical ledger and artifact data.
Allowed a failed Copilot answer-admission turn to collect fresh read-only evidence before its single resubmission, so option-performance replies no longer fail by reusing stale observations.
Classified lifecycle-only option expiries as actual zero-fee events while keeping broker expiries with missing order identity explicitly incomplete until OpenD supplies authoritative fees.

no_release_note.reason: Internal ledger module split preserving the existing public and runtime contracts.

Merge-only integration commit whose constituent changes are reviewed under their owning commits.
Mechanically refreshed generated dependency graph documentation for the already reviewed source tree.
Release-preflight boundary correction exposing existing fee semantics through the canonical ledger API without changing runtime behavior.
